name: Ajigasawa (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Ajigasawa town emblem in white: a broken ring with an arrowhead crossed by a stylised diagonal band of characters.
history: Municipal flag of Ajigasawa, a town in Aomori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 10 May 1977.

features.role: Ajigasawa town emblem — a broken ring with an arrowhead crossed by a stylised diagonal band of characters
